sentences.text:
Accordingly, the present writ petition is allowed and respondents are directed to pay compensation to the petitioner for Khasra No. 64, situated at Chak Barvi, Post Office Chalnair,
Tehsil Kotkhai, District Shimla by treating the same as "Bagicha Bhakhal Aval Faldaar" and not as 'Ghasani'.

The respondents are accordingly directed to pay the difference of the amount, which the petitioner is entitled to alongwith interest @6% per annum from the date of filing of the petition till the date the said amount is actually paid.
No order as to costs."

2. Admittedly land of the petitioner comprised in Khasra No. 64 situated in Chak Barvi, Tehsil Kotkhai, District Shimla, H.P. had been utilized for construction/widening of Theog-Kotkhai-Hatkoti road during the year 2009 onward.
For this purpose, land of the petitioner as well as other villagers was acquired by the State through negotiations by passing a Negotiation Award No. 43 of 2009 on 4.12.2009.

3. In the negotiations, land was agreed to be acquired .
with two classifications, i.e. cultivated and uncultivated land.
At that time, land of the petitioner comprised in Khara No. 64 was recorded as Ghasni.

4. On 20.3.2010 petitioner had filed an application for correction of classification of his land comprised in Khasra No.64, whereupon Collector Settlement Shimla had changed the classification of land in reference vide order dated 9.4.2013 as Bagicha Bhakhal Aval Faldaar.
5. The aforesaid order dated 9.4.2013 was assailed by the State before the Divisional Commissioner by filing appeal, which was dismissed on 31.7.2016.
6. It has been stated that challenge laid to the aforesaid correction before the Financial Boby Sawant vs . State Of H.P. & Others.

7. It is case of the petitioner that he came to know about the recording of nature of the land in reference as 'ghasani' in revenue record at a later point of time and thereafter only, he filed an application for correction in the year, 2010.
8.
Civil Writ Petition No. 1621 of 2015, for execution of direction passed wherein present petition has been filed, was filed by the petitioner on 6.12.2014 which was decided on 17.8.2016.

9. After passing of judgment in CWP No. 1621 of 2015, .
petitioner submitted an application to the Secretary, HP Public Works Department on 15.6.2017,
stating therein that there were 10 trees of Kail in his land, apart from 40 apple plants.
10. Present Execution Petition was filed on 19.12.2016.

11. In compliance of judgment passed in CWP No. 1621 of 2015, Land Acquisition Collector passed supplementary Award No. 18 of 2017 on 18.4.2017 by considering the land of the petitioner as 'Bagicha Bhakhal Aval Faldaar' and, he redetermined the compensation treating as cultivated land and accordingly petitioner was held entitled for 6,07,490/-.

12. During pendency of the Execution Petition, Revised Supplementary Negotiated Award No. 3 of 2023 has been passed by Land Acquisition Collector on 31.3.2023 whereby interest component payable to the petitioner has been enhanced.

13. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that petitioner has not been awarded compensation for 40 apple trees standing on Khasra No. 64.
14.

As there is no averments in the Writ Petition regarding number of apple trees existing in Khasra No. 64 and direction passed by the Court was to acquire the land of the petitioner comprised in Khasra No. 64 as 'Bagicha Bhakhal Aval Faldaar', but not as a 'Ghasni', however without any reference of existence of trees and number thereof, if any, in the land in .

reference, we are of the considered opinion that direction in this Execution Petition, for paying compensation for number of trees as being claimed by the petitioner in the aforesaid land, will be beyond the jurisdiction of Executing Court.

15. For the purpose of claiming compensation for 40 apple trees, claimed to be existing in Khasra No. 64, petitioner may avail appropriate remedy including filing of Reference Petition in accordance with law by leading appropriate evidence therein.

Needless to say that for explaining delay, if any, in filing the Reference Petition, petitioner may claim his entitlement for benefit of Sections 5 and 14 of the Limitation Act as permissible under law.
With aforesaid observation, petition is closed alongwith pending application(s).
